manageFilters.description: The addon manages the filters of the chat tab.

chatIndicators.description: Show unread messages as a number on the chat tab. The number still counts when another tab filters the same lines. Filters on this tab still apply to moved messages.

patterns.description: Regular expressions for private messages. The usual GrieferGames messages are filled in and can be edited. The list applies while the category is on. Invalid expressions are skipped and written to the log.

mentionSound.description: Play a sound when somebody mentions your name in chat.

ampClantagEnabled.description: Replace magic characters in clan tags with readable text.

ampEnabled.name: Replace magic prefixes
ampEnabled.description: Make names with a magic prefix readable and mark them.

ampReplacement.name: New chat prefix
ampReplacement.description: Prefix used to mark names that had a magic prefix.

chatTime.name: Chat time

chatTimeFormat.name: Format
chatTimeFormat.description: Format used for the chat time.

payAchievement.name: Notification
payAchievement.description: Show a notification for incoming payments.

payHighlight.name: Highlight payments
payHighlight.description: Mark verified payments in the chat.

fakeMoneyWarning.name: Warn about fake money
fakeMoneyWarning.description: Warn about fake payments that use a Supreme status.

logBalanceTiming.description: Writes to the log when the cash balance, bank balance, or a payment line arrives, so you can compare the order. Off by default.

bankAchievement.name: Bank notification
bankAchievement.description: Show a notification for bank transactions.

remover.name: Remover
remover.description: Timestamp and notification for the item and mob remover.

lastTimeHover.description: Show the timestamp when you hover a remover message.

colorGradientCloud.name: Chat color gradient (Cloud)
colorGradientCloud.description: Inserts a gradient between two hex colors, for example '##ff0000' and '##00ff00'.

afkNickname.name: AFK nickname (4–16 characters)
afkNickname.description: Your nickname while you are AFK.

afkMsgReply.name: Reply to private messages
afkMsgReply.description: Automatically replies with a fixed text while you are AFK.

afkMsgText.name: Reply text
afkMsgText.description: Text of the automatic reply to private messages.

booster.description: Load boosters on join and hide the menu (1.8).

loadBoostersOnJoin.name: Load on join
loadBoostersOnJoin.description: Loads boosters automatically when you join the server.

hideBoosterMenu.description: Blocks the /booster menu. The overview stays in chat.

friends.name: Friends
friends.description: Show others which CityBuild you are on.

enabled.description: Turns sharing your CityBuild with friends on or off.

showSubServerInDiscord.name: Show CityBuild in Discord

plotBorders.name: Plot borders
plotBorders.description: Line grid around the plot on Nature and Extreme (1.8).

enabled.name: Plot borders
enabled.description: Turns the line grid around plots on or off.

key.name: Key
key.description: Toggles the grid, or holds it while the key is pressed.

activation.name: Activation
activation.description: Toggle keeps the grid on until you press the key again. Hold shows it only while the key is pressed.

notify.name: Show notice
notify.description: Writes in chat when the grid is turned on or off.

heightRange.name: Height around the player
heightRange.description: How many blocks above and below you the grid is drawn.

nearbyPlayers.name: Nearby players
nearbyPlayers.description: Shows nearby players in the HUD. Off by default. No direction and no coordinates, distance only in rough steps. With the defaults, only players you can see directly, and only on citybuilds. Players behind walls appear only if you turn line of sight off – that can violate §2 (5) and (8). Use it only after GrieferGames support has allowed the feature.

enabled.name: Nearby players
enabled.description: Turns the HUD list of nearby players on or off. Off by default.

radius.name: Radius
radius.description: Only players within this many blocks. Default 16, maximum 32.

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: How many players the HUD shows at most, closest first.

onlyLineOfSight.name: Only players in direct line of sight
onlyLineOfSight.description: Shows only players you can see directly. Turning this off also shows players behind walls – that can violate §2 (5) and (8).

distanceDisplay.name: Distance
distanceDisplay.description: Rough steps such as <10 m, or no distance at all. No direction and no coordinates.

onlyOnCitybuild.name: Only on citybuilds
onlyOnCitybuild.description: The list stays hidden on farm worlds, event servers and in minigames.

autoUpdate.name: Automatic updates
autoUpdate.description: Refreshes the item list when it is opened. Otherwise the bundled list stays.

key.name: Hotkey
key.description: Opens the item list. No key is set by default.

open.name: Item list
open.description: Opens the item list in game.

source.name: Source
source.description: Addresses the item list and categories are loaded from.

itemTooltip.name: Item Tooltip
itemTooltip.description: Preview of maps and heads in the tooltip.

mapTooltipPreview.name: Show map in tooltip
mapTooltipPreview.description: Shows a preview of the map in the tooltip.

headTooltipPreview.name: Enlarge head in tooltip
headTooltipPreview.description: Shows the player head larger in the tooltip.

visuals.name: Visual improvements

headEnchantmentGlint.name: Enchantment glint on heads, banners and chests

overstackingFix.name: Overstacking fix for newer versions
overstackingFix.description: Shows the real count when an item is stacked higher than the version allows. On plot axes the number comes from the lore.

source.description: Address the wiki is loaded from.

logPayloads.name: Log payloads
logPayloads.description: Writes incoming payloads to the log, including ones dropped before the join flag is set.
